name: Greenshield-Pattern Sword
description: The elven Greenshield's standard military sword — a straight double-edged blade of recovered Elarith, feywrought to the cut-and-thrust technique Greenshield doctrine emphasizes. Issued to active Greenshield rank rather than owned personally, with the metal returning to house custody when the bearer leaves service.
narrative_effects: Supports standard sword technique with the specific balance elven military training favors.
Edge endurance is unusual: Elarith holds geometry across long service that ordinary steel does not match.
Rare in realm-side hands; the metal itself, recognized by anyone trained in elven smithcraft, raises serious questions about how it left the Feywood.
